mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 7.5% and remains there for two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 7.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A three-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls by >2% over three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines by >2% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point increase in the federal funds rate triggers a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by 25 basis points in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative after a 25bp FEDFUNDS increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth > 200k for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 500k units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 500k for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 500k for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 99 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 99 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 99 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in unemployment rate declines below 6% signals a tight labor market, which raises wage pressure and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines by >0.3 percentage points for two consecutive months and falls below 6%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE declines by >0.3pp for two months and falls below 6% (t-test p > 0.05).
